mutations.name: KB26 U1 Upload no longer asks can_write_project
KB26 U2 Fact extraction no longer asks can_write_project
KB26 U3 Upload sources keyed by slug alone again
KB26 U4 Research upload route accepts any reader of the project
KB26 U5 Aggregator singleton loads project sources too
KB26 P1 Upload content readable by every signed-in user again
mutations.sql: drop policy external_content_read on public.external_content; create policy external_content_read on public.external_content for select to authenticated using (true);

mutations.name: KB26 P2 Upload content readable by anyone who can read the project
mutations.sql: drop policy external_content_read on public.external_content; create policy external_content_read on public.external_content for select to authenticated using (not is_upload or exists (select 1 from public.projects p where p.id = external_content.project_id));

mutations.name: KB26 P3 Upload source names visible to every signed-in user again
mutations.sql: drop policy external_sources_read on public.external_sources; create policy external_sources_read on public.external_sources for select to authenticated using (is_active);

mutations.name: KB26 P4 Source slugs unique across all projects again
mutations.sql: alter table public.external_sources drop constraint external_sources_project_slug_key; alter table public.external_sources add constraint external_sources_slug_key unique (slug);
